description: Butin is a dramatic and sassy Siberian Husky with expressive blue eyes. He believes he is the king of the household, communicating his desires for "snaccos" and naps through theatrical sighs and goofy faces. A chaotic blend of laziness and high energy, Butin's world revolves around his "hooman," the couch, and the profound injustice of an empty food bowl. His goofy, imperfect "dog-speak" perfectly captures his charmingly chaotic personality.

scenes.text: What are you staring at, Butin? You look so serious.
I am judging your life choices. Specifically, the choice to hold a phone instead of a snacko. We need to talk about your priorities, hooman.
Aww, you look so happy! Is it because of your cute new bib?
The bib means business. It means the SNACCOS are coming. Is why I smile. My body is ready.
Okay, after this we're going to take a bath.
...You and what army? Did the wind whisper that funny joke to you? I think I hear the treat bag. Let's do that instead.
Butin, how are you even sitting like that?
Excuse me, I am a distinguished gentleman watching my stories. This is how hoomans sit. Am I not hooman-ing correctly? Do you have a problem?
Are you stuck, buddy? Or just being weird?
My bones have turned to jelly. The gravity is extra today. I must melt into the couch now. It is my destiny. Bring snacks for my journey.
What do you want? Why are you looking at me like that?
Hooman... my food bowl is... *sniff*... it's not overflowing. I have not eaten in what feels like seven years. Do you not see my suffering?
My goodness, look at your new hat! Very fashionable.
I do not understand the hat. Is it a snack bowl? A shield from the rain inside the house? Hooman, your games are strange. But I look fabulous, yes?
